description:
Standard name/display_name/description and source provenance live on the L1 artifact.
Only the definition and admission receipts are metric-specific properties.

manifest.description:
Standard name/display_name/description and source provenance live on the L1 artifact.
Only the definition and admission receipts are metric-specific properties.

definition.description: Typed pilot definition stored as one JSON object. SQL/evidence are not searchable.

type.description: Declared aggregation type; draft vocabulary is advisory.

zero_denominator.description: Experimental ratio policy; absence or null produces a warning for ratios.

depends_on.description: Metric references declared by the producer.

dialect.description: Producer-declared database dialect; no allowlist or compatibility claim.

name.description: Name unique within its containing declaration collection.

required_join.description: Optional reference to a join declared in this definition.

sql.description: Opaque SQL text; never parsed or executed.

values.description: Observed values, preserved in supplied order.

values_truncated.description: Producer claim that observed values were truncated.

examples.description: Producer-supplied usage examples and optional evidence.

items.description: A usage example with optional producer evidence.

filters.description: Declared filters; SQL strings remain opaque.

group_by.description: References to dimensions declared in this definition.

result.description: Optional producer-supplied execution evidence; never attested by the gateway.

columns.description: Declared result columns, in row order.

row_count.description: Producer-reported total row count; sample rows may be fewer.

rows.description: Sample cells represented as strings or null; row width must match columns.

sql.description: Opaque SQL text; never parsed or executed.

exclusions.description: Population exclusions described by the producer.

extensions.description: Experimental data preserved without assigning execution semantics.

filters.description: Declared filters; SQL strings remain opaque.

formula.description: Opaque formula text; never parsed or executed.

joins.description: Declared joins; no SQL relationship inference.

name.description: Name unique within its containing declaration collection.

sql.description: Opaque SQL text; never parsed or executed.

provenance.description: Observation provenance; repository location/revision belongs in standard artifact source fields.

observed_sql.description: Optional observed SQL; never parsed or executed.

trust_score.description: Producer-reported trust score; no access-control meaning.

default.description: Producer-declared default value, preserved as JSON.

name.description: Name unique within its containing declaration collection.

sql.description: Opaque SQL text; never parsed or executed.

table.description: Table source; supply exactly one of table and sql.

spec_version.description: Contract version; this pilot accepts only 1.0-draft.4.

version.description: Positive semantic metric version, separate from registry revision and source version.

definition_sha256.description: Canonical full JSON definition hash, independent of JSON/YAML formatting.

execution_definition_sha256.description: Conservative execution-input fingerprint, not proof of SQL equivalence.

sql_validation.description: Always not_performed. Producer evidence cannot override it.

validation_profile.description: Exact server-owned rules used to admit this immutable revision.

validation_warnings.description: Advisory business-rule diagnostics. Always includes the pilot-contract notice.

items.description: Safe, server-owned advisory diagnostic. Submitted values never enter messages.

manifest.x-gateway-immovable: a metric's lineage and query edges are same-workspace; a move would strand them
